title: Legal Intern / Maritime Law
desc:
Company Description
Aydin Lawyers is a law firm established to deliver practical, solution-focused legal services to clients in the maritime, shipping, and transport industries. The firm is dedicated to helping organizations navigate complex regulatory frameworks and commercial challenges in these sectors. Clients benefit from tailored advice that addresses both operational and legal considerations. Aydin Lawyers values professionalism, analytical thinking, and a commitment to high-quality client service, creating a learning-focused environment for emerging legal talent.
Role Description
This full-time on-site Legal Intern / Maritime Law role is based in Sisli and supports the firm’s legal team in serving clients in the maritime, shipping, and transport sectors. The intern will assist with legal research on maritime and transport regulations, case law, and international conventions. Day-to-day tasks include preparing and reviewing legal documents and contracts, summarizing findings, and helping draft memos and reports. The role also involves supporting legal consulting activities, participating in client meetings under supervision, and maintaining organized case files and documentation. The intern will collaborate closely with attorneys, gaining exposure to maritime disputes, compliance matters, and commercial transactions.
Qualifications
Strong foundation in Law with an interest in maritime, shipping, and transport sectors.
Ability to support Legal Consulting activities, including analyzing Legal Issues and proposing practical options under supervision.
Skills in Legal Document Preparation, including drafting, reviewing, and organizing contracts, memos, and case-related documentation.
Effective Communication skills, including clear written and spoken English and the ability to present legal findings concisely.
Graduated from a law program; coursework or prior experience in maritime or transport law is an advantage.
Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple tasks within deadlines.
Proficiency with standard office software and legal research tools.
Demonstrated integrity, professional conduct, and willingness to learn in a fast-paced legal environment.
